overview.description: The Invesco BulletShares 2034 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF (BSJY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund tracks a market-value-weighted index of USD-denominated, high yield corporate bonds with effective maturities in 2034. BSJY was launched on Jun 10, 2026 and is issued by Invesco.
